```text
# PR #5094: Patch: deeper card stats, X6, Decisiveness on the Experimental tab's Running and Versions

Closes #5036

## What changed

Every row of `GET /api/stats/versions` now sends its play version's **Decisiveness** (R4552001), in both scopes. The Experimental tab's Major patch running, Historical and Versions views show it right after Adjusted, in the table and in the Grid. The figure comes from R4552001's own code; none of its math is written again. The new ruling is **R5036000**, and it amends R4552001, R4675001, R4678001 and R5040000.

- **Engine, `swing.rs`:** new `DecisivenessRow` and `decisiveness_rows`. They only combine R4552001's existing private steps (`term_spreads`, `terms_of`, `decisiveness_field`, `decisiveness_of`) for rows that are not a card's own. A row a rule makes (the Dormant Starship) is read the way `swing_report` reads such a card.
- **Engine, `play_versions.rs`:**
  - `Summed` now keeps the sources its span counts (`span_sources`) and gives its row's turns. A card only a rule makes reads its Created copies' turns.
  - `counted_swing_rows` builds the one baseline every row is read against: each (version, source) pair some row's span counts, taken once, in the query's modes, from every seat.
  - `play_version_figures` fills `PlayVersionFigures.decisiveness` (`None` below R654's floor or with no turns) and `PlayVersionTable.decisiveness` (the typical row's value).
  - `format_play_versions` prints both, so `stats report --versions` and `stats-cards --versions` can check the figures before live games arrive.
- **Wire and web:**
  - `api.ts`: `PublicPlayVersion.decisiveness?` and `PublicStatsVersionsResponse.decisiveness?`.
  - `RunningPanel.tsx`: the column, its Grid entry, the header tooltip (the Cards tab's text plus "Versions played before games recorded their turns have none."), the sort, and the Sort select entry after Adjusted. Decisiveness leaves R4678001's list of sorts that read as Adjusted.
  - `zh-CN.json`: the Chinese tooltip.
- **Spec:** `spec/rulings/R5036000.md`, `spec/pending/5036.md`, an "Amended by" line and a title update in each of the four amended notes, and two sentences in §9.11. `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/history/` and `spec/11-rulings.md` are untouched.

## How it was tested

- `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --lib -- r5036000 r4675001 r4678001 r5040000 r4681`: 17 passed. All of `wire::stats` (106 tests) also passed. The four new tests:
  - over one version, a row's figure equals the Cards tab's for that card over the same records;
  - over two versions, it reads the summed tallies against one baseline, and differs from both a v1-only reading and a baseline without the other card's span;
  - a span with no turn rows has none;
  - the Starship reads its Created copies' turns.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server -- r5036000 r4675001 r4552003 r5040000 r4681001`: 8 passed. The new server test checks that core-001's live row equals its value on `/api/stats/cards` exactly, in both scopes, and that the body's value equals `tiers.decisiveness`.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools -- versions`: passed.
- The five touched web test files (`stats.test.tsx`, `versions.test.tsx`, `hallOfFame.test.tsx`, `CreatedPanel.test.tsx`, `i18n.test.ts`): 171 passed.
- The harness's web set, `vitest run --project web --changed d7f8bbf22c` with the same excludes: 448 of 449 files passed. One test timed out at 30 s while the whole suite ran (`almanac-preview-stinkyscapeplus.test.tsx`, R3572000); it touches nothing this change does, and run alone it passed 4/4.
- Also green: web typecheck, eslint on the touched files, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-engine -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and `cargo jackioh spec check` ("2681 rulings … ok"). `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` printed `Internal`.

**UI check.** I compared the base commit on :5174 with this branch on :5173, with `/api/stats/cards` and `/api/stats/versions` mocked in the browser:
- **1280×720:** the only difference on Historical is the new Decisiveness column between Adjusted and Since. It reads ±14.2% etc., and "not enough games" for the row below the floor. The header tooltip ends "A typical card: ±12.1%. Versions played before games recorded their turns have none."
- **Versions:** an old version with games but no turns reads "not enough games". The table fits its container at 1280 (1078/1078 px).
- **390×844:**
  - The page stays one screen (document 390×844) and the table scrolls sideways inside its own container.
  - The Grid lists Tier, Adjusted, Decisiveness, Games, Since without overflow.
  - The Experimental tab scrolls fully into view.
  - Two things look the same before the change: the Since column wrapping onto several lines, and the tab row clipped at the right edge.
- I did not run Cypress spec 46 locally. It runs in CI's `e2e smoke` on this pull request, and the measurements above are what it checks.

## Decisions the issue left open

1. **The baseline counts every seat**, as the Cards tab's `windowed_swing_rows` does. Rejected: counting only the seats `?pilot=` names.
2. **One baseline for the whole table**, over every (version, source) any row's span counts. Rejected: a baseline per row, which would put rows on different scales.
3. **The engine sends `null` below the floor.** Rejected: gating on the client only.
4. **On the client, `null` reads "not enough games" and a missing field reads "—".** Rejected: the Cards tab's "—" for a row that has games but no turns; for a past version that is the usual case, and "not enough games" says why.
5. **The body sends its own typical value**, and the header tooltip names it. Rejected: reusing the Cards tab's `tiers.decisiveness`, which is read over a different set of cards.
6. **The text output prints the figure.** Rejected: putting it in `--json` only.

## Where I departed from the plan

- `hall_of_fame.rs`: its test helper `table()` also builds a `PlayVersionTable`, so it needed the new field. It gets `DecisivenessField::PRIOR.typical`.
- The Starship engine test also sets `created_used`. Without it the card has no Created stats row.
- In the server test I moved the 40 records into a shared `swing_records(prefix)` helper instead of copying them.

## Worth a second look

- The Hall of Fame's rows are the same `PlayVersionFigures`, so `/api/stats/hall-of-fame` now sends `decisiveness` too. The client ignores it, and R5036000 says so.
- Until enough play versions have 20 turns each, the figure uses the named priors. Every past version recorded before #4552 will read "not enough games" for good, as the issue expects.
